description: This file defines the Properties class for reading and processing document properties from an XLSX file within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for extracting core, extended, and custom properties from XML data, utilizing external classes for XML scanning and property management.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: Class responsible for reading and parsing document properties from XLSX files, including core, extended, and custom properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the security scanner and document properties objects.

methods.name: nullOrSimple
methods.description: Utility method to return the SimpleXMLElement if the input is an instance, otherwise null.

methods.name: extractPropertyData
methods.description: Loads and scans XML string data, returning a SimpleXMLElement if successful.

methods.name: readCoreProperties
methods.description: Parses core document properties from XML data and sets them in the document properties object.

methods.name: readExtendedProperties
methods.description: Parses extended document properties like Company, Manager, and HyperlinkBase.

methods.name: readCustomProperties
methods.description: Parses custom properties from XML and sets them as custom properties in the document properties object.

methods.name: getArrayItem
methods.description: Utility method to safely retrieve an item from an array, returning null if not available.
